name: Kōriyama Castle
text: Kōriyama Castle (郡山城, Kōriyama-jō) is a flatlands-style Japanese castle located in the city of Yamatokōriyama, Nara Prefecture, Japan. Its ruins have been protected as a National Historic Site since 2023. It is No.194 on the list "Continued 100 Fine Castles of Japan".

depictions.name: Koriyama Castle
depictions.text: Kōriyama Castle was a castle in northwestern Yamato, Japan. Its ruins have been designated as a protected National Historic Site since 2023.
